faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the New Mangalore Port Authority (NMPA) for selecting eligible retired personnel for specialized consultancy services.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by NMPA?
faq.answer: NMPA has advertised for the post of Consultant (Official Language) on a contract basis under this official employment notification.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in NMPA Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Consultant (Official Language) position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the filled application form along with required documents is 08 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted in offline mode. Candidates need to download the form and send it by post to the designated authority.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit to apply for Consultant (Official Language)?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 63 years as specified in the official notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualifications are required for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Hindi or English from a recognized university with relevant professional experience as a Hindi Officer.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary or remuneration provided for this role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive remuneration based on their basic pension at the time of retirement as per relevant Government of India orders.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the completed application be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should reach the Secretary, New Mangalore Port Authority, Panambur, Mangalore - 575010 or via email to [email protected] before the deadline.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application form directly from the official NMPA website at https://newmangaloreport.gov.in/.
